newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus in corn, wheat tenders.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus in corn, wheat tenders.

text.p: The Cyprus Grain Commission on Wednesday invited tenders for the supply of a combined shipment of 10,000 tonnes spring and 8,000 tonnes of durum wheat, plus a shipment of 18,000 tonnes of corn.
Shipment for the combined wheat cargo is scheduled at the end of April or the beginning of May, while the corn shipment is scheduled the beginning of May.
Both tenders close on April 8, a statement from the grain commission said.
